embed.title: !quest
embed.description: Alerts for field research rewards at pokestops. Every reward you name becomes its own rule.

fields.name: Pokemon rewards
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}quest pikachu`
`{{prefix}}quest pikachu dratini d:500` — either one, within 500 m
`{{prefix}}quest vulpix form:alola` — one form only
`{{prefix}}quest shiny pikachu` — only rewards flagged as shiny

fields.name: Item rewards
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}quest rare_candy`
`{{prefix}}quest golden_razz_berry amount:3` — 3 or more
`{{prefix}}quest fast_tm`
One item per command. `{{prefix}}info items` lists the item names; write spaces as `_`.

fields.name: Stardust, pokecoins, candy, mega energy
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}quest stardust` — any amount; `stardust:1000` — 1000 or more
`{{prefix}}quest pokecoins` — any amount; `pokecoins:10` — 10 or more
`{{prefix}}quest candy:lapras` — Lapras candy; bare `candy` — any species
`{{prefix}}quest energy:charizard` — Charizard mega energy; bare `energy` — any
`amount:N` sets a minimum for items, candy and energy.

fields.name: Several rewards at once
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}quest pikachu rare_candy stardust:1000` — three rules
`{{prefix}}quest everything` — every reward type
`{{prefix}}quest all_pokemon` / `{{prefix}}quest all_items` — every pokemon / item reward
Your admin may restrict `everything`, `all_pokemon` and `all_items`.

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
With neither `d:` nor `area:`, your `{{prefix}}area` list is used (unless your admin set a default distance).
`d:500` — within that many metres of your location
`location:home d:500` — measured from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only these areas instead of your list; several: `area:north,south`. Can't be combined with `d:`

fields.name: Options
Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}quest remove pikachu`
`{{prefix}}quest remove stardust`
`{{prefix}}quest remove all_items` — every item rule
`{{prefix}}quest remove all_pokemon` — every pokemon rule
`{{prefix}}quest remove pikachu summary` — only the summary-mode rule
`{{prefix}}quest remove everything`
`{{prefix}}quest remove id:12` — one rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
